summary: Tested new admin-only Finansal Rapor (GET /api/admin/financial-report) backend + /admin/financial-report frontend. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass (access control, default 12-month shape, net_balance math, month=YYYY-MM, empty state, branch/category/teacher filters, transfers-excluded). Frontend: Found and fixed a runtime crash 'cashboxes.map is not a function' caused by /api/cashboxes returning {cashboxes:[...]} while AdminFinancialReport treated it as array. After the small defensive fix, all UI verifications pass: summary cards, 4 charts (Genel + Matematik/Fen Bilimleri/Türkçe), 12 monthly rows, optional line toggles, branch filter re-renders charts, empty state message appears for 2020-01, teacher (buse.ozakdas) is blocked by ProtectedRoute and redirected to /login.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime crash 'cashboxes.map is not a function' — /api/cashboxes returns {cashboxes:[...], total_balance:N} but component set state directly with response body. Fixed defensively to accept both shapes.

action_items: Consider standardising /api/cashboxes response shape (return array like other list endpoints) OR update all consumers similarly. Current fix in AdminFinancialReport handles both.
Long-term: introduce a small useReferenceData hook or wrapper that normalises list endpoints returning {items:[...]}.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminFinancialReport blindly assigned response.data to arrays without checking shape; add Array.isArray guards for any list endpoints (bug source).
server.py _fin_month_range uses guard=240; fine but a start_ym > end_ym silently returns empty list (documented behaviour, acceptable).
sd/ed defaults '0000-01-01'/'9999-12-31' work for string comparison but are non-standard; consider using explicit min/max dates.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. test_transfers_excluded creates a cashbox transfer (999 TL, 2026-09-15) and attempts cleanup via DELETE /api/cashbox-transfers/{id}; if the endpoint isn't idempotent-cleanable, a small residual transfer may remain but transfers are excluded from the report anyway.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Financial report backend + UI validated. If /api/cashboxes response shape is normalised, the defensive parsing in AdminFinancialReport.jsx can be simplified. Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_financial_report.py covers access control, math, filters and transfer exclusion.
rca_of_the_issue: AdminFinancialReport.useEffect loadRef() called setCashboxes(cb.data). /api/cashboxes actually returns {cashboxes:[...], total_balance:N} (unlike /branches, /teachers, /bank-accounts which return raw arrays). Rendering later called cashboxes.map(...) on an object → TypeError crashed the whole page. Mitigation: normalise with Array.isArray(cb.data) ? cb.data : (cb.data?.cashboxes || []).
